title: Canada unveils counter-tariffs of 15% to 50% on US goods as trade war intensifies
subhead: Under Canada's planned response, US steel and aluminum products previously subject to a 25% duty will soon face 50% tariffs. Goods facing 25% tariffs will include appliances, dairy products and certain steel and aluminum derivative products.

Lacking a military solution against Iran, Trump turns to economic suffocation
subhead: As midterm elections approach, the Trump administration is favoring economic pressure over military involvement, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announcing Monday some 60 new Iranian entities, individuals and ships have been added to the sanctions list. Tehran in turn denounced 'economic terrorism.'

title: Iran's purchasing power is slowly collapsing under US economic pressure
subhead: As Washington ramps up pressure on Tehran, the Iranian rial continues its downward spiral, and concerns spread across the markets. But behind the bleak economic statistics, households bear the brunt, cutting spending, savings and essential expenses.

title: Retro 'sunflower' pools bring nostalgia to Paris region and beyond
subhead: 'Aquatic Monuments' (5/6). The Tournesol pool, an emblem of prefabricated and modular architecture, spread throughout France in the 1970s, leaving its mark on generations of swimmers with its flying saucer-like appearance. Built in 1976, the Raymond-Mulinghausen pool in Les Lilas, on the edge of Paris, still welcomes swimmers in an almost unchanged setting.

title: Soldier testimony sheds light on how Israel wages information war
subhead: One year after the bombing that killed 22 people, including five journalists, at Nasser Hospital in the south of the Gaza Strip, an Israeli soldier has told several media outlets, including Le Monde, how the Israeli army pulls out all stops to link bombing victims to Hamas.

title: Want peace and quiet in France? These are the best places to buy property
subhead: For many people in France, the goal is to hear only the sounds of nature and to avoid being caught up in a tide of tourists. The good news is that in most areas where peace and quiet can still be found, real estate prices remain low.

title: Unprecedented crisis grips US colleges, squeezed by soaring costs and Trump-fuelled distrust
